finding: The study identified several risk factors significantly associated with preterm birth, including multiparity, maternal age, history of preterm delivery, hypertensive disorders, inadequate antenatal care compliance, previous cesarean section, multiple gestations, antepartum hemorrhage, polyhydramnios, oligohydramnios, and PROM.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery rates were significantly lower in the preterm group compared to full-term deliveries, with a higher rate of emergency cesarean sections.
